commitments.detail: The cart will be available in the central equipment room at 8:00 AM for backup use.
Please ensure the cart is charged and all probes are covered before use.
Post-use disinfection of the cart is mandatory.
The portable ultrasound cart will be assigned to the intensive care unit for Monday morning use.
The vascular access service will have access to the cart in the central equipment room if needed.
The vascular access service will be provided with the portable ultrasound cart at a later time.
The vascular access service will receive the cart after the intensive care unit is finished.
